name: celiador-ai
description: Celiador's AI layer — chat and agent, wired to the Celiador daemon.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The Celiador agent reads and edits files in your workspace. Security-sensitive settings (authentication URLs, tokens, auto-approval) are restricted in untrusted workspaces.

celiador.daemonUrl.description: Base URL of the Celiador daemon the AI layer talks to.

celiador.supabaseUrl.markdownDescription: Override the Supabase/GoTrue base URL used for sign-in. Leave empty to use the value from the daemon's `GET /api/config` (self-hosted defaults to the daemon URL).

celiador.token.markdownDescription: Optional shared-secret fallback for the daemon agent endpoint (`CELIADOR_AGENT_TOKEN`). Normally leave empty and sign in with **Celiador: Sign In** — your Supabase session is used instead.

celiador.provider.markdownDescription: Where the agent runs. `anthropic`: call Claude directly (needs an API key). `daemon`: route through the Celiador daemon (`celiador.daemonUrl`) using `celiador.token` — no client-side API key; the daemon holds the credential.

celiador.apiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key for `anthropic` provider (fallback). Prefer the **Celiador: Set API Key** command, which stores it in the OS keychain via SecretStorage. Resolution order: SecretStorage → this setting → `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

celiador.autoApproveEdits.description: Apply the agent's file writes without asking. When off (default), each write to a new/changed path requires confirmation.

celiador.effort.description: Reasoning effort for the agent (higher = more thorough, more tokens).
